//: Upgrade tiers for scripts/upgrade.mjs. The distributed zip contains the template's git-tracked source; the overlay decides each incoming file's fate by matching these globs. DEFAULT is CORE (overwrite). 'keep' files are NEVER written (designer-owned). 'review' files are written to a '<path>.upgrade-new' sidecar and flagged, never overwritten in place. Glob support: '**' (any depth), '*' (one segment), exact paths. Matched against the repo-relative POSIX path.

keepNotes.src/variations/**: The designer's designs live here — the whole point of Option A. Never touch.
keepNotes.src/app/pages.ts: Designer's page list (data). pages.schema.ts is CORE.
keepNotes.src/app/menu.ts: Designer's nav menus (data). menu.schema.ts is CORE.
keepNotes.pnpm-lock.yaml: Vercel builds from it with --no-frozen-lockfile, so new template deps still resolve; regenerating needs pnpm, so don't clobber.

reviewNotes.package.json: Hybrid: template scripts/deps + any deps the designer added. Written as package.json.upgrade-new for the designer to merge.
reviewNotes..claude/settings.json: Hybrid: template allowlist + any permissions the designer added.

coreNotes: Everything else is CORE and overwritten: build config (vite.config.ts, vercel.json, middleware.js, index.html, postcss.config.*), scripts/**, .claude/commands/**, .claude/launch.json, .claude/hooks/**, CLAUDE.md, README.md, the app machinery + base chrome + tooling under src/app/** (except the two KEEP data files), src/config/**, src/data/**, src/styles/** (base tokens.css/brand.ts are template DEFAULTS under Option A — the designer's palette lives in their variation), src/version.ts, and public/version.json (so the local version marker advances and the update pill clears).
excludedNotes: cloud-export/ is app-internal IP and is NOT distributed at all — the template ZIP plugin (vite.config.ts) filters it out of `git ls-files`, so it never enters template-latest.zip and the overlay never has it to write. Also .gitattributes export-ignore keeps it out of `git archive`.
